# A Garment Can Outlive Its File — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-83877
Voiceover: A garment record becomes institutional evidence when material, date, maker, identifier, and rights remain attached.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Mary Tavener Holmes, 1983

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CN08-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · IDENTIFY — Can object and file find each other?. Assign stable identifiers to garment, component, container, digital folder, preservation copy, image, and related record; never rely on filename or shelf memory alone.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CN08-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · DESCRIBE — What evidence belongs to each medium?. Record physical material, construction, wear and condition separately from file provenance, format, metadata, rights, version, and fixity. Link without collapsing.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CN08-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · CARE — What threatens survival?. Assess handling, light, pests, humidity, storage materials, damage, hardware, software, format, bit integrity, access, vendor, and backup with appropriate specialists.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN08-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · USE — How will access avoid harm?. Define handling, digitization, research, display, reproduction, privacy, cultural restriction, loan, treatment, and correction rules; record every intervention.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S39
Voiceover: Universal Electronic Records Management Requirements, Version 3 is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration

Rights: Government resource; link/download for education and do not imply endorsement.
